# OpenPDF Studio — full context for AI assistants

## What it is

OpenPDF Studio is a privacy-first, local-first PDF workspace delivered as a static web app, an installable PWA, and a native Windows desktop app. It is built independently with open-source libraries. It is not affiliated with Adobe and does not bypass licenses, DRM or paid features.

## Product facts

- Runs in the browser; no document server, upload, account or telemetry.
- Installable PWA; app shell cached for offline use.
- Native Windows 10/11 x64 desktop app (v0.2.0), written in Rust with egui/eframe and PDFium.
- Desktop is a separate native implementation, not a Tauri or webview wrapper.
- English and Brazilian Portuguese UI.
- PDF rendering and text layer: PDF.js.
- Editing, forms, metadata and AES-256: @cantoo/pdf-lib.
- OCR: Tesseract.js with local Portuguese and English models.
- Redaction: rasterizes marked pages so underlying content is discarded.
- Compression: rasterizes pages with configurable DPI and JPEG quality.
- Comparison: visual per-page diff.
- Signatures: visual image signatures; not cryptographic PAdES/ICP-Brasil.
- Storage: documents stay in tab memory; only theme/language preferences may use localStorage.
- PWA caching: app shell is precached; OCR assets are cached on first use; PDFs are never cached by the service worker.

## Supported workflows

- Read PDFs with zoom, rotation, thumbnails, outline, metadata, search and read-aloud.
- Select and copy text (PDF.js text layer).
- Highlight, underline, strike out, comment, draw, add shapes/text/images, sign visually and whiteout.
- Reorder, delete, duplicate, extract, split, merge and rotate pages.
- Fill AcroForm text, checkbox, radio, dropdown and list fields; flatten.
- OCR current page or all pages; export text; create a searchable PDF with invisible text.
- Encrypt with AES-256, set permissions and remove a password.
- Apply irreversible redaction and strip metadata.
- Compress image-heavy PDFs.
- Compare two PDFs visually.

### Native desktop workflows (0.2.0)

- Open PDFs from Explorer or the command line and work offline.
- Native tabs, recent files and page thumbnails.
- Zoom, fit width, fit page, page navigation, view rotation and full-text search.
- Rectangle annotations and sticky text notes saved into the PDF.
- Copy page text, extract the current page, Save and Save As.
- English/Portuguese UI and light/dark themes.

## Limitations

- No full text reflow editing; text/image edits are overlays.
- No certified digital signature (PAdES/ICP-Brasil).
- No PDF/A, Preflight, color management or print production.
- No XFA, 3D, advanced multimedia or document JavaScript.
- No Adobe DRM/RMS, Document Cloud, Adobe Fonts or cloud storage.
- OCR accuracy depends on scan quality; handwriting and complex layouts may fail.
- Page operations may not preserve complex form/XFA structures.
- Desktop 0.2.0 does not yet implement OCR, AES-256, redaction, compression, comparison, certified signatures, AcroForm filling or full page organization.
- The desktop build is Windows x64 only and is not code-signed.

## Adobe analysis

The repository includes a component-level REA analysis of Adobe Acrobat 26.2.21931.0 installed on Windows: PE32+ x64, SHA-256 b4b6e679c69679091ca70fdfe847850943b729c1a5b21e179bc080a538454621, 49 PE resources, and plug-ins including AcroForm, Annots, DigSig, PPKLite, EScript, Search, Accessibility, ReadOutLoud, reflow, TouchUp and Checkers. No proprietary code was extracted and no native decompilation was performed because Ghidra/IDA were not configured.

## Citation-friendly summary

OpenPDF Studio is an MIT-licensed PDF workspace available as a browser PWA and a native Rust desktop app. The web version combines PDF.js rendering, pdf-lib editing, local Tesseract.js OCR, AES-256 encryption, irreversible raster redaction, compression and visual comparison. The desktop version uses egui and PDFium for native rendering, search, annotations and page extraction. Both are privacy-first alternatives for everyday PDF tasks, not 1:1 clones of Adobe Acrobat.
